QF.id: Cat III AIF Overview and Growth_34

question.text: A 'Family Office' in the Cat III AIF ecosystem typically:

answer.text: Allocates capital as an investor into AIFs for diversification

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook treats family offices as AIF investors and market participants — family office accounts and consultants have helped deploy funds to the AIF industry as a diversification tool, and family offices feature among investor-meeting targets. The Trap: Family offices do not lend to AIFs or regulate them; defining them narrowly as a "single-family" wealth manager misses their role as AIF capital allocators. Note: Engage family-office accounts and consultants as anchor investors when distributing Cat III AIF products.
